name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWE.unique_decoding
title: Two-sided decoding: short error differences in a lattice with large minimum coincide
statement: Let Lambda be a subgroup of Z^m whose nonzero vectors all have a coordinate of absolute value at least B. If delta - delta' lies in Lambda and |delta_i| + |delta'_i| < B for every coordinate, then delta = delta'. With Lambda = L_q(A^T) and B = q this is the farness half of TDRE correctness (AJLW26, Lemma 3.2 and Theorem 6.1): decoding a difference b1 - b2 returns the true error difference or nothing, never a different short error.
